purpose: Run structural-document analysis as controlled repeatable cycles with deterministic checks, specialist semantic gates, residual queues and canonical promotion rules.

M1F-PRIMARY-GEOMETRY-REVALIDATION.parent_ingestion_rule: The parent wrapper cannot PASS until every FPEP sub-item is COMPLETE, the P12 receipt exists and is cited in parent audit_paths, and both canonical gates are ingestible.

stages.rule: Read the primary sheet independently. Do not copy sections, topology or dimensions from adjacent storeys. Produce claims with DOC/MIS/RIF/INF/INC/ND provenance. Delegated wrapper items must execute their registered subpipeline instead of collapsing it into one generic semantic result.

Canonical promotion is allowed only when output exists, provenance is explicit, no blocking conflict remains, required audit exists and the artifact is registered with compatible authority/state. The semantic executor must submit exactly one result packet through the agent-result handshake; the ingestor verifies promotion but never manufactures canonical evidence. For delegated wrappers, the ingestor additionally verifies delegated-queue completion and its final receipt.

global_rules.source_priority: written dimensions/text and explicit identifiers on immutable primary sources outrank raster scale, historical datasets and inference
global_rules.extended_support_rule: physical support centroid is not automatically an analytical beam node; preserve faces and multiple beam incidences
global_rules.stable_checkpoint_rule: PT G1-G9, current PT Master, PT handoff and common storey registration are not reopened unless direct primary-source evidence conflicts with a specific claim
global_rules.foundation_primary_geometry_rule: M1F foundation analytical assembly is blocked behind FPEP. Before FPEP-P07, primary foundation readers, metric solver, topology builder and adjudicator may not receive legacy foundation topology/count targets, PT Master coordinates, M0-G geometry, TAV-01A reinforcement groups or historical calculation topology as geometry-generating context.

github_actions_can: advance queue/state only after promotion evidence exists
delegate a registered wrapper to its specialist sub-orchestrator
specialist_agent_required_for: approving a claim for canonical promotion when visual evidence is required
writing the single-item semantic result packet
automation_boundary.fully_unattended_semantic_execution: Requires an authorized external agent executor. A scheduled project agent may act as that executor only within the single-item contract. The deterministic orchestrator must not weaken semantic gates when no executor is connected. Delegated pipelines retain their own single-item boundary and information barriers.
